edges.reason: transfer() forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value), which performs the actual balance mutation.
transferFrom requires ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating any balance.
ensure falls back to require(condition(_from,_value)) for non-whitelisted callers.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with raw +/- arithmetic and no reentrancy guard.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value is unchecked and can underflow.
balanceOf[_to] += _value is unchecked and can overflow the credited balance.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] unconditionally.
msg.sender is compared with _from and used as the allowance spender, so the debited account depends on the caller.
msg.sender is the allowance owner written by approve.
transfer uses msg.sender as the _from argument.
delegate guards the arbitrary delegatecall with require(msg.sender == owner).
_mints is gated only by msg.sender == owner or a hardcoded address, so any leak of that key mints arbitrary supply.
batchSend verifies msg.sender == owner before moving balances.
init verifies msg.sender == owner before writing sale parameters.
setTradeAddress verifies msg.sender == owner before whitelisting an address.
The constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and grants the full supply to the deployer.
owner is the sole gate of the delegate function.
owner is the primary gate of the _mints function.
owner is the sole gate of batchSend.
owner is the sole gate of init.
owner is the sole gate of setTradeAddress.
ensure whitelists any transfer where _from or _to equals owner, bypassing all sale limits.
delegate performs a.delegatecall(b) against an arbitrary address, executing untrusted code that can re-enter and mutate this contract's storage.
The target address parameter a of delegate() becomes the delegatecall destination.
The calldata parameter b of delegate() is executed verbatim in this contract's context.
ensure decides the whitelist bypass using the caller-supplied _from address.
ensure reads canSale[_from], so any address flagged by _mints skips the condition() sale limits.
ensure whitelists tradeAddress as a trusted sender.
ensure whitelists the constant UNI router address.
ensure computes the canonical Uniswap pair address through pairFor.
The pairFor result is stored in the local _UNI used for the whitelist comparison.
Local _UNI is compared with _from inside ensure, allowing any pair address to bypass restrictions.
pairFor assigns the derived CREATE2 address to the local pair variable.
condition reads the global _saleNum quota configuration.
condition compares _value against the _minSale bound.
condition compares _value against the _maxSale bound.
condition reads the per-address _onSaleNum counter.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after each successful transfer.
_mints computes addedValue*(10**uint256(decimals)) with unchecked multiplication.
The computed mint amount is written directly into balanceOf[spender] without caps.
_mints sets canSale[spender]=true, permanently whitelisting the address and bypassing ensure/condition.
init writes token*(10**decimals) into _minSale.
init writes maxToken*(10**decimals) into _maxSale.
init writes the supplied saleNum into _saleNum.
init scales the token bounds using the decimals constant.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication.
The _value parameter feeds the unchecked total multiplication in batchSend.
The recipient array length feeds the unchecked total multiplication in batchSend.
The unchecked product is stored in the local total variable.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total can underflow if the product exceeds the sender balance.
batchSend decrements the sender balance with raw unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend credits each recipient with _value inside the loop.
Recipient balance addition balanceOf[_to] += _value is unchecked.

The loop index i selects the recipient _tos[i] for the local _to.
batchSend iterates using the index i until _tos.length is reached.
